ECHO LAB - Third-party asset notices
Prepared for the private EchoLab game project. All selected downloads cost 0.
Unity target: 6000.3.25f1, Universal Render Pipeline 17.3.0.

Axel Kulomaa - Modular Concrete Interior 3D
https://axel-kulomaa.itch.io/modular-concrete-interior
License: CC0. Concrete/metal maps were repacked for URP.

Madduck - Free Modular 3D hospital environment
https://madduck.itch.io/modular-3d-hospital-environment
Publisher permits use and modification in games, with private development-team sharing.
Standalone redistribution as game assets is excluded. Keep this material in the game project and private team source.

bitkiln - PSX Horror FPS Kit Free Sampler
https://bitkiln.itch.io/psx-horror-fps-kit-free-sampler
See FirstPerson/LICENSE.txt. Use/modification in personal and commercial projects allowed.
Standalone asset/template redistribution is excluded.
Only the flashlight and arms were selected; no firearm was imported.

Quaternius - Animated Human
https://opengameart.org/content/animated-human-low-poly
License: CC0. See Human/License.txt.

City Building Game Art / HorrorGameMaker.com - 3D Horror Game Monster
https://opengameart.org/content/3d-horror-game-monster
License: CC0. Selected black skin, Idle, Walk and Run meshes/clips.

codeinfernogames - 3d Keycard
https://opengameart.org/content/3d-keycard
License: CC0.

nisu - Scifi Generator
https://opengameart.org/content/scifi-generator
License: CC0. DirectX normal green channel converted for the prepared OpenGL-style normal.
Metallic and inverted roughness were packed to URP metallic/smoothness channels.

a52 / rubberduck / Yughues - PBR Industrial Asset Pack
https://opengameart.org/content/pbr-industrial-asset-pack
Source archive retained outside the Unity project. Industrial .blend models were not imported.

Custom ECHO LAB prefabs (pressure plate, switch, keycard reader, alarm, security door,
terminal and light fixture) were assembled for this project from primitive meshes and prepared materials.
These are visual/physics building blocks. Time Loop, puzzle interaction and enemy AI are not implemented by this collection.
